One morning, a green bottle struck the rocks below, flashing between folds of foam. He hauled it up with a net and found a tightly rolled note inside. Near midnight, a small boat emerged from the darkness, guided by its steady golden beam toward shore.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一台暂时放慢的机器。路灯把空荡的街道染成淡黄，清洁车缓缓驶过，留下湿润而明亮的路面。便利店仍亮着白光，店员倚在柜台后打盹。远处偶尔传来出租车的声音，又很快消失。高楼的窗户大多沉默，只有零星几盏灯守着未完的工作、失眠的人和刚醒的梦。天边渐渐泛蓝，第一班公交车进站，面包店飘出温热的香气，城市在微寒的风里重新呼吸。","w03":"- Recursion is when a task solves itself by asking a smaller version of the same task for help.\n- It needs a stopping rule, like reaching the smallest box in a stack of boxes.\n- Then each smaller answer returns upward until the original task is finished."}
